items.title: Chick Corea — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I used to do six-week stints up there with the Sister Sadie All-Stars, with Blue Mitchell’s band

ctx.x: But then you wind up in Blue Mitchell’s, a gig you would have been as well qualified for as anybody, having transcribed so many of his solos.

Well, look at the fortuitousness of that, which is me in love with that band, Blowin’ The Blues Away. There’s that band, and when Horace wasn’t doing Horace Silver Quintet gigs, Blue would take the group and do gigs. He needed a piano player. I still can’t remember how I got that gig, but I ended up in that piano chair, and did some recordings, and played gloriously with that band. It was a great experience for me.
What sorts of freelance things were you doing in New York during those years? Can you name a few highlights?
